name: @veltara/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Veltara (common + domain YAMLs)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle profiles --output src/.bundled/profiles.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle profiles --output src/.bundled/profiles.json && redocly bundle strategies --output src/.bundled/strategies.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle strategies --output src/.bundled/strategies.json && redocly bundle recommendations --output src/.bundled/recommendations.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle recommendations --output src/.bundled/recommendations.json && redocly bundle gates --output src/.bundled/gates.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle gates --output src/.bundled/gates.json && redocly bundle marketplace --output src/.bundled/marketplace.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle marketplace --output src/.bundled/marketplace.json && redocly bundle freezes --output src/.bundled/freezes.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle freezes --output src/.bundled/freezes.json && redocly bundle audit --output src/.bundled/audit.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle audit --output src/.bundled/audit.json
